title: Sending a document by fax
description: The file, the recipient and the result of the transmission are kept in a history you can follow.

blocks.text: Some recipients still take documents by fax. For the sender, starting the transmission is not the only thing that matters.

quote.text: Sent a 12-page fax. It took way longer to send than advertised. Shows a confirmation, but the business said they’ve never gotten got nothing. This app does not work as described.
quote.app: FAX from iPhone: Send Doc App

blocks.text: Before sending, show all the pages and the recipient’s number; afterwards, an accessible receipt and the state of the attempt. Keep replies next to the document they belong to.
A transmission being accepted and a person reading it are different events; the interface has to name them exactly.
